svg.title: Risk console: live replay of the engineer approval gate
svg.desc: Animated replay of the mock-up risk console. A cursor approves or dismisses the four ranked assets one by one, the open-alert counter counts down from 4 to 0, and each decision lands in the outcome log.

g.text: Human gate: the system ranks and explains. Engineers approve every action. No auto-shutdown, no set-point changes in the pilot.
